display.purpose: Hero heading only. One instance per page at 44px.

headline.purpose: Section titles, brand mark in nav (22px), and fit score readout label.

title.purpose: Feature card labels, button text, subheadings within panels.

body.purpose: All instructional copy, descriptions, prose output. Max ~72ch line length.

label.purpose: Input labels, column headers, tag text, metadata. Always Ink Secondary.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Default card and panel shadow. Lifts the surface above Launch White. Used at rest.

shadows.name: lift-strong
shadows.purpose: Card hover state where hover elevation is meaningful, e.g. the feature tab grid.

shadows.name: catalyst-glow
shadows.purpose: Applied alongside a 2px Catalyst border on selected or focused states. The only color-tinted shadow in the system.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions (border color, background, shadow).

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Button hover, input focus, upload zone activation. Short enough to feel instant.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main CTA for each feature panel. Always labeled with an action verb.

components.name: Primary Button (disabled)
components.description: Disabled state — teal never appears, gray communicates unavailability.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary-disabled { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #9ca3af; color: #fff; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; padding: 11px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: not-allowed; line-height: 1.4; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Standard single-line input with Catalyst focus state.

components.name: Textarea

narrative.overview:
CareerAI's design is built around forward momentum. Where most productivity tools are passive and neutral, CareerAI is propulsive — every screen is a preparation phase, and the interface knows it. The visual language is confident without being aggressive: warm surfaces keep it human, sharp detail keeps it precise, and the Catalyst accent marks every point where progress happens.

The typography pairing is the spine of this system. DM Serif Display carries authority — it appears on brand marks, hero moments, and the fit score readout where a user meets their competitive reality. DM Sans carries everything else with efficient clarity. Together they create the feeling of a highly capable system that still respects the emotional weight of a job search.

Depth is structural, not decorative. Cards use light diffuse shadows to establish foreground hierarchy. The only color-based depth signal is the Catalyst glow on selected states — a precise, momentary burst of energy that confirms the user has activated a step in the sequence.
keyCharacteristics: Propulsive: the design moves the user forward through a defined sequence
Warm precision: warm off-white foundation offsets any clinical feel from tight layout and exact type
Catalyst restraint: the accent color appears only where action or progress occurs
Serif authority / sans clarity: the two fonts never compete; each owns its layer
Data-forward: semantic color surfaces appear only for real feedback data

rules.name: The Catalyst Rule
rules.body: The Catalyst accent (#0EA5A0) is reserved for interactive elements and active data states. It never appears as decoration, background wash, or purely informational text. Three Catalyst marks on one screen is approaching the limit.

rules.name: The One Palette Rule
rules.body: Dark mode uses the same semantic hue roles at adjusted lightness. No new colors are introduced in dark mode — the system shifts values, not vocabulary.

rules.name: The Launch-then-Land Rule
rules.body: Serif type launches a section — hero, brand mark, fit score. Sans lands it — instructions, labels, actions, output. Never use DM Serif Display for body text, and never place both fonts at the same visual weight within a single component.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Every surface except the card container is flat at rest. Shadows appear to establish foreground hierarchy (Lift) or to confirm an active state (Catalyst Glow). Neither is decorative.

dos: Do use DM Serif Display exclusively for the hero heading, brand mark, section titles, and the fit score readout.
Do apply the Catalyst accent (#0EA5A0) only to primary CTAs, selected states, active zones, and score indicators.
Do signal selected or active state with the combination of a 2px solid Catalyst border and the Catalyst Glow shadow (0 0 0 3px rgba(14,165,160,0.1)).
Do use the semantic surface pairs (success / risk / caution) exclusively for data feedback.
Do write all button labels and CTAs as action verbs with direct objects.
Do keep all feature panel content within a max width of 860px, centered.
donts: Don't use DM Serif Display below 18px or in instructional body copy.
Don't apply the Catalyst color to decorative elements, background washes, or non-interactive text.
Don't introduce a third typeface, a second accent color, or additional radius values.
Don't use the success/risk/caution surface colors for informational hierarchy or marketing purposes.
Don't exceed the 860px content max-width inside any feature panel.
Don't use generic placeholder text — every input has a specific task context.
